summary: The team is in a critical push to resolve an Outlook account lockout while advancing the knowledge website redesign and executing a China-first global marketing strategy for Asia Start and Intelligent China.
summaryDetail: Immediate attention this week is on resolving the Outlook account lockout by resetting passwords, re-adding the account on all devices, and confirming with JSB that the backend lock is lifted. The knowledge website redesign is progressing with decisions to integrate videos into topics, enhance the homepage with more articles and prominent indices, and maintain a two-menu structure; Joseph, Julie, and Joker need to meet for specific feedback and implement changes. In global marketing, the strategy prioritises China-based programs (Asia Start and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with US programs on hold; Joseph must draft target areas and provide a conversion tracking brief, while the team analyses participant profiles. Upcoming deliverables include Ira's tasks: drafting the AmCham Shanghai Sustainability Awards application, sending the CKGSB-IE report promotion email, reviewing Asia Start spotlight and videos, and sending summary emails to Zongchao and the GP team about Tech in Asia Conference engagement. The newsletter is approved and ready to send, and a meeting with UN Women is scheduled for Tuesday at 10:30 a.m.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Design Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed two design versions for the knowledge website, comparing the current layout with Joseph's inspiration. They agreed the menu categorization is an improvement but noted the overall design remains similar, and discussed incorporating more articles and indices while removing outdated videos.

meetings.title: CKGSB Global Marketing Strategy Meeting
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing China-based programs (Asia Star and Intelligent China) for SEO and marketing, with US programs as secondary. They reviewed conversion tracking setup and assigned tasks to gather audience data and clarify tracking definitions.

decisions.text: Remove the videos panel and integrate videos into topics instead of having a separate category.
Keep the two-menu structure with 'Knowledge' and 'School' menus.
Display more articles on the homepage, including a pinned article and a section for latest articles.
Bring indices (BCI, BSI, CKGSB) more prominently onto the knowledge homepage.
Do not include a stock market ticker at the top of the homepage.
Prioritize Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for marketing efforts, with US programs on hold initially.
Consider Berkeley program as a third priority for audit phase.
Ira approved the newsletter with no further comments
